markdown.description: The document, as its file holds it. Diagrams are ```mermaid fenced blocks. Raw HTML is shown as text. Give either this or file.

file.description: The document as a Markdown file sent with --attach, in place of markdown. Give either this or markdown.

path.description: Where the file lives, as you would name it to the person, such as docs/design.md.

context.description: What you want the person to look at, or what changed since the last round. Shown above the document; Markdown.

attachment.description: A file sent beside the payload with --attach, by its name.
